This volatile convergence demands immediate, decisive action. Therefore, we direct the immediate prioritization of comprehensive digital infrastructure audits to preempt AI-agent vulnerabilities, the urgent diversification and localization of critical supply chains to cushion against escalating logistics costs and economic instability, and the reinforcement of emergency preparedness protocols for all physical assets and personnel situated in seismically active zones.
